Rashi on Menachot 8a:10:1.hebrew: ומשני, כי מצריך קרא להביא שלם — למצוה בעלמא. ולעולם, אם קדשה לחצאין — מקודש, ואינה יוצאה שוב לחולין:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:10:1.english: And [the Gemara] answers: The verse requires bringing a whole [tenth] only as a general mitzvah [ab initio]. But in any case, if one sanctified it in halves, it is sanctified, and it can no longer go out to [become] non-sacred.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:10:2.hebrew: והא חוקה כתיב בה - "חק עולם לה'" וגו' (ויקרא ו׳:ט״ו), דמשמע מתוך שלם:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:10:2.english: But "statute" is written regarding it - "A statute forever to the Lord," etc. (Leviticus 6:15), which implies [that it must be brought] from a whole [tenth].

Rashi on Menachot 8a:10:3.hebrew: אלא להביא עשרון שלם מביתו - אבל לענין קידוש בכלי שרת, אם רצה, מקדש לחצאין:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:10:3.english: Only to bring a whole tenth [of an ephah] from his home - But with regard to sanctification in a service vessel, if he wishes, he may sanctify it in halves.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:11:1.hebrew: ודעתו להוסיף - להשלים עשרון, כדאמרינן לקמן בפרק המנחות והנסכים (מנחות דף קג.), דאין מנחה פחותה מעשרון, דהאומר "הרי עלי חצי עשרון" מביא עשרון שלם:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:11:1.english: And his intention was to add - To complete a tenth [of an ephah], as we say later in the chapter [entitled] "Hamenachot Vehanesachim" (Menachot 103a), that no meal offering is less than a tenth, for one who says, "It is incumbent upon me [to bring] half a tenth," brings a full tenth.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:11:2.hebrew: ואם איתא - שר' יוחנן סובר דגבי חביתין אינו קדוש:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:11:2.english: And if it is so - [that Rabbi Yoḥanan holds] that with regard to the griddle-cakes [of the High Priest], [half a tenth] is not sanctified:

Rashi on Menachot 8a:12:1.english: And they shall slaughter - It is written with regard to peace offerings.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:12:2.hebrew: פתח אהל מועד - בעזרה. וכיון שעזרה כשרה, כל שכן דהיכל (שלם) כשר, דלא תהא עזרה שהיא טפל חמורה מן העיקר. אלמא, יליף היכל מעזרה:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:12:2.english: The entrance of the Tent of Meeting - [This means] in the Temple courtyard. And since [slaughtering in] the courtyard is valid, all the more so [slaughtering in] the Sanctuary is valid, for the courtyard, which is secondary, should not be more stringent than the principal [area]. Evidently, [Rabbi Yoḥanan] derives [the law of] the Sanctuary from [that of] the courtyard.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:13:1.english: Full - Both of them full of fine flour.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:13:2.hebrew: אין מלאים - שהיו מלאים ממש המזרקים סלת, אלא מלאים — כל העשרונות שקדשו בתוכו — שלמים היו:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:13:2.english: There is no “full” - [in the sense] that the basins were literally full of fine flour; rather, “full” [means that] all the tenths that were sanctified in it were whole.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:14:1.hebrew: ורב - דאמר במפריש חצי עשרון, שאינו קדוש:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:14:1.english: And Rav - who said that one who sets aside half of an issaron [of flour], it is not sanctified.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:14:2.english: From the griddle-cakes - [let him derive] and [let them] be sanctified [in halves].

Rashi on Menachot 8a:15:1.hebrew: מילתא ממילתא לא יליף - הילכך שאר מנחות לא אמר דליהוו כחביתין, דחביתין דין הוא דלקדשו לחצאין, אבל שאר מנחה לא:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:15:1.english: He does not derive one matter from another matter - Therefore, [Rav] did not say that the other meal offerings should be like the griddle-cakes [of the High Priest]; for with regard to the griddle-cakes, it is logical that they be sanctified in halves, but [with regard to] the other meal offerings, no.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:15:2.hebrew: מנחה קדושה בלא שמן - אם נתן עשרון סולת בכלי שרת, אע"פ שאין שם שמן, הרי היא קדושה ולא יצא לחולין, וצריך להביא שמן ולהקריבה:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:15:2.english: A meal offering is sanctified without oil - If one put an isaron of fine flour into a service vessel, even though there is no oil there, [it is sanctified,] and it does not go out to [the status of] non-sacred, and one must bring oil and offer it.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:15:3.hebrew: שכן מצינו בלחם הפנים - שהיא מנחה, ואין בה שמן, אבל לבונה יש בה, כגון בזיכין:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:15:3.english: As we find with regard to the shewbread - For it is a meal offering, and it has no oil in it, but it does have frankincense in it, such as the [two] bowls [of frankincense placed beside it].

Rashi on Menachot 8a:16:1.hebrew: מנחת נסכים - הבאין עם כל הזבח, כדכתיב בתמיד (במדבר כ״ח:ה׳) ״עשירית האיפה סלת למנחה בלולה בשמן״ וגו'. ואין בה לבונה:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:16:1.english: The meal offering of libations - Those that come with every [animal] sacrifice, as it is written regarding the daily offering (Numbers 28:5): "a tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mingled with oil," etc. And it has no frankincense.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:16:2.hebrew: על כרחך כרבי יוחנן ס"ל - בחביתין דלא קדשה, הלכך גמר שאר מנחות מחביתין:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:16:2.english: Perforce, he holds like Rabbi Yoḥanan - regarding the griddle-cake offering, [he holds] that it is not sanctified [in halves]. Therefore, he derives [the law of] the other meal offerings from the griddle-cakes.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:18:1.hebrew: האי בלא האי - שמן בלא סלת ובלא לבונה, ולבונה בלא שמן וסלת. שכן מצינו בבזיכין, שמקדשין את הלבונה בלא שמן וסלת. ואי קשיא, הא אתי לחם הפנים בהדייהו? לאו פירכא היא, שהרי אינו מתקדש עם הלבונה בבזיכין. ומיהו אשכחן דכלי שרת מקדשין לבונה שבתוכן בלא שמן וסולת:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:18:1.english: This without that - Oil without fine flour and without frankincense, and frankincense without oil and fine flour. For we find in the bowls that they sanctify the frankincense without oil and fine flour. And if you object: But the shewbread comes along with them? This is no refutation, since [the bread] is not sanctified together with the frankincense in the bowls. And in any case, we find that service vessels sanctify the frankincense that is inside them without oil and fine flour.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:1:1.hebrew: ואם איתא - דדם לא קידש לחצאין, לילף מנחה מדם:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:1:1.english: And if it is so - That blood is not sanctified in halves, let [Rabbi Elazar] derive [the law of a] meal offering from blood.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:1:2.english: From which he removed a handful in the Sanctuary is valid - Even though its law is [to be performed] in the courtyard, like other sacrifices.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:1:3.hebrew: שכן מצינו בסילוק בזיכין - דהיא בהיכל, אלמא דאיכא קמיצה בהיכל, דסילוק היינו קמיצה:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:1:3.english: As we find regarding the removal of the bowls - Which is [performed] in the Sanctuary, indicating that there is taking of the handful in the Sanctuary, for removal is [the equivalent of] taking the handful.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:3:1.english: Before he dismantled it - [Referring to] the arrangement of the showbread on Shabbat.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:3:2.hebrew: הלחם פסול - דהויא לה מנחה שחסרה קודם קמיצה, ואמרינן לקמן (מנחות דף ט:): מן המנחה, פרט לשחסרה. ובלחם הפנים גופיה אמר לקמן (מנחות דף יב:): [קדש קדשים] היא, שאם נפרסה אחת מחלותיה, כולן פסולות:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:3:2.english: The bread is unfit - For it is [considered] a meal offering that became lacking before the removal of the handful, and we say later (Menachot 9b): "From the meal offering" — excluding [a meal offering] that became lacking. And regarding the shewbread itself, [the Gemara] says later (Menachot 12b): "[It is most holy] — it is," that if one of its loaves was broken, all of them are unfit.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:3:3.hebrew: משפרקה נפרס לחמה הלחם פסול - אף ע"ג דלאחר סילוק (מצה) נפרס, פסולה; דהוי שירים שחסרו בין קמיצה להקטרה, ואמרינן לקמן (מנחות דף ט:) דאע"ג דמקטירין קומץ עלייהו, שיריים אסורים באכילה:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:3:3.english: Once he detached it, [if] its bread broke, the bread is disqualified - Even though it broke after the removal (of the matzah), it is disqualified; for it is [considered] remnants that became lacking between the removal of the handful and the burning [on the altar], and we say later (Menachot 9b) that even though they burn the handful on their account, the remnants are forbidden to be eaten.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:3:4.english: And he burns the bowls on its account - [That we do not] derive [it] from a meal offering.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:5:1.hebrew: קודם קמיצה - דהא עדיין לא פירקה, ומיפסל. דהא אמר לקמן: מן המנחה — פרט לכשחסרה מכשיעור. אלמא לא יליף מנחה ממנחה:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:5:1.english: Before the removal of the handful - For [the shewbread] had not yet been detached [from the Table], and [the frankincense] would be disqualified. For [the Gemara] says below: "from the meal offering" — this excludes [a meal offering] that became lacking from its required measure. Evidently, [Rabbi Elazar] does not derive [the law of] one meal offering from another meal offering.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:6:1.hebrew: לעולם מנחה ממנחה יליף, ולא דמי לחם הפנים לשאר מנחות. דמנחה לא בריר קומץ דידה, שהכל ביחד. הלכך, קודם קמיצה ליכא למימר כמאן דקמצה דמיא, דהא מחוסר מעשה:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:6:1.english: Actually, [the law of] a meal offering is derived from [another] meal offering, but the shewbread is not similar to other meal offerings. For in [the case of an ordinary] meal offering, its handful is not clearly designated, since everything is together. Therefore, before the removal of the handful, one cannot say that it is considered as though he had removed the handful, because it still lacks an act.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:6:2.hebrew: אבל לחם הפנים בריר קומץ דידהו - דקאי בבזיכין באפי נפשיה. הלכך, משהגיע זמנה לפרוק, כמאן דקמצה דמיא:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:6:2.english: But the shewbread — its handful is clearly designated - For it [the frankincense] stands in the bowls by itself. Therefore, once the time has arrived to detach [the bread], it is considered as though he had removed the handful.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:7:1.english: And is it not a dispute? - Later in our passage.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:8:1.hebrew: מנחה מחציתה - מנחה תמיד, מחציתה בבקר וגומר. הביא מנחה שלימה של עשרון, דאין מנחה פחותה מעשרון, ואח"כ חוציהו:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:8:1.english: A meal offering, half of it - A perpetual meal offering, half of it in the morning, and so on [as the verse continues]. [The verse means:] He brought a whole meal offering of one issaron, since there is no meal offering smaller than an issaron, and afterward he divided it.

Rashi on Menachot 8a:8:2.hebrew: מחיצתה - משמע מחציתה של מנחה שלימה זו שלפניו:
Rashi on Menachot 8a:8:2.english: Mechetzata ("half of it") - This implies half of this whole [meal offering] that is before him.

Tosafot on Menachot 8a:1:1.hebrew: ואם איתא לילף מדם - וא"ת: והא בדם ליכא מתוך, והכא איכא מתוך; ובשאר מנחות משמע דמודה רבי אלעזר דאין קדושה לחצאין, כיון דלא קרבין לחצאין? ומיהו יש לפרש, דדם נמי קרב לחצאין, שיש ד' מתנות וז' הזאות דפרה, שכל אחת עבודה בפני עצמה; ושיעור טבילה דלעיל לאו למעוטי חצי הזאה, אלא שיהא בכלי שיעור ז' הזאות. והא דאמרינן (בסמוך) גבי הפריש חצי עשרון ודעתו להוסיף, דאמר רב אינו קדוש, [ופריך]: ואי כרבי אלעזר ס"ל לילף מחביתין — מצינו לפרש, דחשיב ליה דעתו להוסיף כמו טעמא דמתוך, וקדוש לחצאין; ועוד, דאפילו ליכא מתוך בשאר מנחות, מ"מ כיון דקדשי חביתין לחצאין מאיזה טעם שיהיה, ילפינן שאר מנחות מינייהו. אי נמי, הא דנקט רבי אלעזר טעמא דמתוך, משום דרבי יוחנן נקטיה: דאפילו פלגיתו בשאר מנחות, בחביתין אודו לי מיהת מטעם מתוך:
Tosafot on Menachot 8a:1:1.english: And if it is so, let him derive [it] from blood - And if you say: But with blood there is no [rationale of] "mitokh" [that since it is offered in halves, it is sanctified in halves], whereas here [regarding the griddle-cakes] there is "mitokh"; and regarding other meal offerings, it implies that Rabbi Elazar concedes that there is no sanctification in halves, since they are not offered in halves? However, one can explain that blood, too, is offered in halves [i.e., in parts], as there are four applications [of blood on the altar] and seven sprinklings of the [red] heifer, each one of which is an act of service in its own right; and the "measure of dipping" [mentioned] above was not to exclude half a sprinkling, but rather [to require] that there be in the vessel a measure of seven sprinklings. And as for that which we say (nearby) regarding one who set aside half a tenth [of an ephah] and his intention was to add [to it], where Rav said, "It is not sanctified," and [the Gemara] objects: "And if he holds in accordance with Rabbi Elazar, let him derive [it] from the griddle-cakes!" — we can explain that [the Gemara] considers "his intention to add" like the rationale of "mitokh", and [thus] it is sanctified in halves. And furthermore, even if there is no "mitokh" in other meal offerings, nevertheless, since the griddle-cakes are sanctified in halves—for whatever reason that may be—we derive other meal offerings from them. Alternatively, that which Rabbi Elazar formulated the rationale of "mitokh", he formulated it on account of Rabbi Yoḥanan: [namely,] "Even if you disagree regarding other meal offerings, in [the case of] the griddle-cakes at least concede to me on account of the rationale of 'mitokh'!"

Tosafot on Menachot 8a:1:2.hebrew: מנחה שנקמצה בהיכל כשרה שכן מצינו בסילוק בזיכין - ואם תאמר: אמאי לא קאמר כדי שלא יהא טפל חמור מן העיקר, כדאמר בסמוך גבי שלמים ששחטן בהיכל, וגבי כהנים נכנסין בהיכל ואוכלים קדשי קדשים ושירי מנחות? י"ל, דהתם כתיב (ויקרא ג) פתח אהל מועד, (שם ו) בחצר אהל מועד; שייך למימר שלא יהא טפל חמור מן העיקר, לפי שתלה הכתוב באהל מועד:
Tosafot on Menachot 8a:1:2.english: A meal offering from which a handful was taken in the Sanctuary is valid, for so we find with the removal of the bowls - And if you say: Why does he not say [that it is valid] so that the secondary [area] should not be more stringent than the primary [area], as [the Gemara] says nearby regarding peace offerings that one slaughtered in the Sanctuary, and regarding priests who enter the Sanctuary and eat offerings of the most sacred order and the remainders of meal offerings? One can say: There, it is written: "the entrance of the Tent of Meeting" (Leviticus 3), [and] "in the courtyard of the Tent of Meeting" (ibid. 6); [therefore] it is applicable to say that the secondary [area] should not be more stringent than the primary [area], since the verse made [it] dependent upon the Tent of Meeting.

Tosafot on Menachot 8a:3:1.hebrew: מקטיר עליו את הבזיכין - פירש בקונטרס: דלא גמרינן ממנחה. ולא היה לו לפרש כן, דלקמן (מנחות דף ט:) פריך מינה למ"ד שיריים שחסרו בין קמיצה להקטרה אין מקטיר קומץ עליהן, ומשני: רבי אלעזר היא. גם שמועה זו א' אפשר ליישב:
Tosafot on Menachot 8a:3:1.english: "The priest burns the bowls of frankincense on account of it" - [Rashi] explained in the Kuntres that [this is] because we do not derive [the law] from [one] meal offering [to another]. But he should not have explained it this way, for later (Menachot 9b) [the Gemara] raises a difficulty from this [baraita] against the one who says that if the remainders [of a meal offering] became deficient between the removal of the handful and its burning, the priest does not burn the handful on account of them, and [the Gemara] answers: It is [in accordance with] Rabbi Elazar. This teaching, too, cannot be reconciled.

Tosafot on Menachot 8a:8:1.hebrew: מאי טעמא דרבי יוחנן - וא"ת: לימא משום דיליף מדם? ושמא קבלה היה בידו טעם זה. אי נמי, כדפרישית לעיל, דלאפוקי דרבי יוחנן מפרש ר' אלעזר טעמא דמתוך (ראשון ראשון קדוש ולית ליה דרבי יוסי):
Tosafot on Menachot 8a:8:1.english: What is the reasoning of Rabbi Yoḥanan - And if you say: Let [the Gemara] say [that his reasoning is] because he derives [it] from blood? [One can answer:] Perhaps he had a tradition that this was the reason. Alternatively, as I explained above, it is in order to exclude [the view] of Rabbi Yoḥanan that Rabbi Elazar explains the reasoning of "since" (that each one first is sanctified first, and [Rabbi Yoḥanan] does not hold like Rabbi Yosei):
